entities.name: Lutri
entities.description: A little otter on Ikoria who stole an arrow from Vivien Reid and vanished beneath the waves.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Arkbow arrow Lutri stole.

entities.name: Otterfolk
entities.description: Playful, daredevil animalfolk of the Valley on Bloomburrow who live on rafts and chase storms.

events.summary: Lutri steals an arrow from Vivien Reid's quiver and uses it to release a creature, then vanishes beneath the waves.
events.quote: Lutri once stole an arrow from the quiver of the planeswalker Vivien Reid
